title: Malicious code in dowload_ebok_mein_fur_immer_by_b_h_bartsch_jjche (npm)
description: The npm package 'dowload_ebok_mein_fur_immer_by_b_h_bartsch_jjche' contains malicious code that compromises any computer on which it is installed or running. The compromise is severe enough that all secrets and keys stored on the affected computer should be rotated immediately from a different, uncompromised machine. Removing the package alone may not eliminate all malicious software, as the attacker may have gained full control of the system.
